glosses: A publication, usually published daily or weekly, containing news and other articles. Traditionally a print publication typically printed on cheap, low-quality paper; today usually digital and often also available in print.

examples.text: There is, however, one habit of reading which has become almost a social evil; and that is the habit of reading newspapers which many indulge in, morning, noon, and night.

Le sentiment de révolte que l’on rencontre dans les classes pauvres se colorera dès lors d’une atroce jalousie. Nos journaux démocratiques entretiennent cette pas­sion avec beaucoup d’art, dans la pensée que c’est le meilleur moyen d’abrutir leur clientèle et de se l’attacher ; […].
